descriptors.purpose: development observation of missing native export Err description and LastDllError preservation
descriptors.module_source:
Private Declare PtrSafe Function NativeMissing Lib "C:\Work\DnaCalc\codex-runs\calcvba-exact-native-probe\scalar.dll" Alias "Absent" () As Long
Private Declare PtrSafe Sub NativeSetError Lib "kernel32" Alias "SetLastError" (ByVal value As Long)
Public Function RunProbe() As String
    Dim value As Long, prior As Long
    NativeSetError 1234
    prior = Err.LastDllError
    On Error Resume Next
    value = NativeMissing()
    RunProbe = CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description & "|" & Err.Source & "|" & CStr(prior) & "|" & CStr(Err.LastDllError)
End Function
